body.name: unpadded whole-set confidence interval
body.construction: \(\mathrm{CI}_n=[\max\{0,\widehat\theta_{L,n}-c_{n,1-\alpha}/\sqrt n\},\min\{1,\max\{0,\widehat\theta_{U,n}+c_{n,1-\alpha}/\sqrt n\}\}]\), using the totalized endpoint estimators and generalized-inverse conditional quantile; on the off-support event that the displayed lower endpoint exceeds the displayed upper endpoint, set \(\mathrm{CI}_n=\{0\}\).
